notes.title: RIFTSTORM Demo Character Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hello weavers,[/p][p][/p][p]After a few months of tweaking, we’ve decided to release one of our in-development characters to the demo for everyone to try.[/p][p][/p][p]Please welcome the newest member to your team: Codename: [b]Thistle.[/b][/p][p]Thistle is a high-skill summoner operative that will be deployed into the field with a unique artifact: her ancient grimoire codenamed: M-0877.[/p][p]Please note that this character is still in development and may be adjusted in the future.[/p][p][b]
Important:[/b] For all returning players, please click the Clear Data button when starting the game. This will delete all previous gameplay data but will be necessary to play the updated build. 

Changelog:  
- Added: Weaver Thistle to character loadout and selection 
- Implemented: Minor performance updates which should fix load-times between missions 
- Fixed a small UI bug in the Mission Center that can flicker in high-resolution monitors 
- Fixed a UI scaling error that caused crashes on Steam Deck, this should fix the performance on Steam Decks as well  

Happy hunting, 
The RIFTSTORM Dev team [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43792726/9a9c05046b47cea6fb82f5f4b111d4a98b578c42.jpg"][/img][/p]
